# Setup CCA Environment

Set up a local Continuous Clearing Auction development environment for Uniswap Liquidity Launchpad with Foundry.

**Repository:** [github.com/Uniswap/continuous-clearing-auction](https://github.com/Uniswap/continuous-clearing-auction)

## [Prerequisites](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/guides/setup\#prerequisites)

- [Foundry](https://getfoundry.sh/)
- Access to a local terminal that can run `anvil`

## [Step 1: Clone the Repository](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/guides/setup\#step-1-clone-the-repository)

```
git clone https://github.com/Uniswap/continuous-clearing-auction.git
cd continuous-clearing-auction
```

## [Step 2: Install Foundry (if Needed)](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/guides/setup\#step-2-install-foundry-if-needed)

Developing with CCA locally requires [Foundry](https://getfoundry.sh/).

```
curl -L https://foundry.paradigm.xyz | bash
```

## [Step 3: Install Dependencies and Build](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/guides/setup\#step-3-install-dependencies-and-build)

```
forge install
forge build
```

## [Step 4: Run Optional Checks and Start a Local Node](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/guides/setup\#step-4-run-optional-checks-and-start-a-local-node)

Install pre-commit hooks if you want automated checks before commits.

```
pre-commit install
pre-commit run --all-files
```

Start a local node for local scripts and tests.

```
anvil
```

Remappings are preconfigured in `foundry.toml`. Adjust them only if you import CCA into an existing Foundry project.

## [Verification](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/guides/setup\#verification)

- `forge build` completes without errors.
- `anvil` starts and listens on `http://localhost:8545`.
